resources.name: Crystal structures of wurtzite ZnO and rocksalt NiO

access.notes: Bulk unit cells for ZnO (P63mc) and NiO (Fm-3m) available from the Materials Project or ICSD.
The molecular structure can be built from standard S–O and O–O bond lengths and angles found in the literature.

resources.name: Open-source DFT code (Quantum ESPRESSO or CP2K)

access.notes: Must support GGA-PBE, spin polarization, Hubbard U, and a plane-wave cutoff of at least 400 eV. CP2K is an alternative.

resources.name: PBE PAW pseudopotentials for Ni, Zn, O, H, S, C

access.notes: Standard PAW datasets from the public repository of the chosen DFT code.
Post-processes charge density to compute atomic charges.
